==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|available}}, {{m|enm|avayllable}}, {{m|enm|avayleable}}, equivalent of {{suf|en|avail|able}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/əˈveɪ.lə.bəl/|[əˈveɪ.lə.bɫ̩]|a=RP,GA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-available.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/əʋ.leː.bɘl/|/ə.ʋeː.lə.bɘl/|/ə.ʋɛː.lə.bɘl/|a=North India}}
* {{IPA|en|/ə.ʋej.lə.bɘl/|a=South India}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj}}

# Such as one may [[avail]] oneself of; [[capable]] of being used for the [[accomplishment]] of a [[purpose]].
#: {{ux|en|We have an '''available''' candidate.}}
#* {{RQ:Orczy Miss Elliott|chapter=The Affair at the Novelty Theatre|passage=For this scene, a large number of supers are engaged, and in order to further swell the crowd, practically all the '''available''' stage hands have to ‘walk on’ dressed in various coloured dominoes, and all wearing masks.}}
# Readily [[obtainable]].
#: {{ux|en|The list shows the '''available''' products in the store.}}
# {{lb|en|legal}} [[valid|Valid]].
#: {{ux|en|This is an '''available''' plea.}}
# {{lb|en|archaic}} Having [[sufficient]] [[power]], [[force]], or [[efficacy]] to achieve the purpose; availing, effective.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1861|title=Mountain Charley|author=E. J. Guerin|page=22|text=One thing however, I finally settled upon—and that was, if I ever ''did'' meet him that I would shoot him precisely as I would shoot a mad dog. In order to make this plan '''available''', I had {{...}} armed myself with a revolver.}}
# [[free|Free]] to [[meet]] someone, [[speak]] on the [[telephone]], enter a [[romantic]] [[relationship]]{{,}} or the like.
#: {{ux|en|I have a question for you when you're '''available'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|Hi, this is Mark Smith calling. Is your mother '''available'''?}}
#: {{ux|en|I asked her if she was '''available''', but she said she had a boyfriend.}}
#* {{RQ:en:New York Times|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/5663866/2024/07/28/steven-van-de-velde-child-rapist-olympics-beach-volleyball/|title=Steven van de Velde brings yet another moral hazard to the Olympics|date=2024-07-28|author=Matthew Futterman|text=Van de Velde did not make himself '''available''' to journalists. “He wants to rest his mind,” Immers explained.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240809142255/https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/5663866/2024/07/28/steven-van-de-velde-child-rapist-olympics-beach-volleyball/|archivedate=9 August 2024}}

====Synonyms====
* {{s|such as can be availed of}} {{l|en|usable}}, {{l|en|profitable}}, {{l|en|advantageous}}, {{l|en|disponible}} {{q|nonstandard|rare}}; {{l|en|vacant}} {{q|of a location}}
* {{s|readily obtainable}} {{l|en|gettable}}, {{l|en|on offer}}, {{l|en|going}}, {{l|en|disponible}} {{q|nonstandard|rare}}
* {{s|legally valid}} <!--{{l|en|effectual}},{{attn|en| according to OED, this sense of the term is obsolete, last attested from 1689}}--> {{l|en|valid}}

====Antonyms====
* {{antsense|such as can be availed of}} {{l|en|unavailable}}
* {{antsense|free to enter a relationship}} {{l|en|taken}}
